name: Interpretive Divergence Mapping Registry
purpose: Map where independent reviewers produce divergent but admissible readings of theorem packages to identify ambiguity thresholds.

mapped_divergences.note: Reviewers vary on the precise numerical bound for neighborhood stability.
Varying emphasis on E-aspect vs delta-aspect during selection.
Attempt to read local proofs as global laws rejected by governance.
Occasional confusion between delta selection and Delta transition (resolved by disambiguation).

governance_rules.rule: Admissible divergences must be recorded to improve framework notation; inadmissible divergences must be neutralized.
